answer.value: Trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a curated mixture of reasoning and non-reasoning data, as a single system that can invoke chain-of-thought reasoning (<think>) or direct inference (<nothink>). Safety alignment is also achieved through SFT on helpfulness and harmlessness data. Built on the Phi-4-Reasoning backbone with the SigLIP-2 vision encoder in a mid-fusion architecture.
quotes: Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision-15B is trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a carefully curated mixture of reasoning and non-reasoning data.

The safety alignment is achieved through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) using data that includes both helpfulness and harmlessness examples, as well as targeted questions and answers across multiple safety categories.
Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision-15B is a compact open-weight multimodal reasoning model built on the Phi-4-Reasoning language model backbone and the SigLIP-2 vision encoder, using a mid-fusion architecture.
